Core Modules

The Complete Delivery Intelligence Platform

Six interconnected AI modules eliminating every source of delivery complaint before it reaches your customer.

RF

Complaint Risk Fingerprinting

AI constructs a unique risk profile for every order using 40+ behavioral signals including complexity, prep time, transit distance, staffing levels, and historical failure patterns.

PD

Pre-Dispatch Prevention Engine

Real-time intervention triggers at the packing stage — packaging upgrades, item verification checklists, and dispatch timing optimization before the order leaves.

FA

Failure Attribution Forensics

Identify exactly where failures occur — kitchen errors vs delivery partner delays — with irrefutable, timestamp-backed evidence for aggregator dispute resolution.

IC

Operational Intervention Center

AI-generated, step-by-step interventions pushed to staff in real-time. No manual analysis required. Clear, immediate, actionable guidance at the packing station.

OL

Outcome Learning Memory

Every intervention tracked and mapped to real delivery outcomes, continuously improving prediction accuracy and building your restaurant's permanent operational DNA.

CC

Manager Command Center

360-degree visibility into every active order, risk alert, refund risk, and KPI — all unified in one powerful management dashboard with live data.

Our Story

Built From The
Kitchen Floor Up

Delivery Complaint Prevention was born from a real problem. Founder Hardik Badhwar, managing high-volume pizza operations in Harlow, Essex, watched restaurants lose thousands weekly in avoidable refunds — not because of bad food, but because of predictable, preventable failures nobody could see coming.

He built the engine he wished he had. Today, DCPE is the UK's leading AI-powered pre-dispatch complaint prevention platform serving restaurants, takeaways, cloud kitchens, and franchise groups across Britain.

2026
Year of Complaint-Free Deliveries
176K+
UK Hospitality SMEs Addressable

Hardik Badhwar

Founder & CEO

"Our mission is simple: prevent every complaint before it happens and create effortless delivery experiences that customers love."

8+
Yrs Ops
5
Pilots
28%
Less Complaints

Mission Statement

To empower independent UK food service operators to achieve operational excellence by leveraging AI-driven predictive intelligence — eliminating service failures, protecting net margins, and restoring customer trust in the digital delivery ecosystem.

Vision Statement

To be the global standard for Predictive Food Operations — a future where every takeaway and restaurant operates with total dispatch reliability, consistent service quality, and data-driven resilience in a delivery-first economy.

Core Values

OI

Operational Integrity

Forensic data accuracy and elimination of service failures through reliable, real-time predictive insights across every delivery.

RS

Resilience

Empowering independent operators to recover margins and protect brand reputation against the volatility of digital delivery platforms.

SX

Simplicity

Making advanced AI intelligence accessible through low-friction interfaces that integrate seamlessly into busy kitchen workflows.

AC

Accountability

Transparent, data-backed evidence ensuring fairness in dispute resolution and operational management at every level.

EM

Empowerment

Equipping food service entrepreneurs with the technical foresight to optimize performance and scale without increasing complexity.

PT

Partnership

Building long-term relationships with operators as a trusted intelligence partner, not just another software subscription.

Company Timeline

2024
The Idea Takes Shape
Hardik Badhwar identifies the Service Reliability Gap during high-volume pizza operations in Harlow, Essex. Initial research and prototype concept development begins.
2025 Q1
R&D and Model Development
Complaint Risk Fingerprinting model architecture designed. UK-specific ML training data gathered from real restaurant workflows and live delivery outcomes.
2025 Q3
Pilot Deployment
8-week pilot across 5 UK locations achieves 28% complaint reduction and 18% refund recovery. Market validation survey collects 182 responses with 87.3% pilot interest.
2026
UK Soft Launch
Official London launch targeting 10-15 independent takeaways. Business plan submitted for investment. The Year of Complaint-Free Deliveries begins.
2027
Full UK Expansion
Scale to 50-100 multi-site food businesses across Manchester, Birmingham, Leeds, Glasgow. Full API integration with Deliveroo, Just Eat, and UberEats.
2028+
International Markets
Entry into Berlin, Amsterdam, Dubai. 300+ restaurant partners. Community Quality Network federates anonymized learning across global takeaway data.

Prevention Module

Pre-Dispatch
Prevention Engine

Intercepts every high-risk order before it leaves the kitchen. Generates specific, step-by-step interventions for staff in real-time.

1.8km • 15min ETA • Normal

#4826 — Family Box
3.4km • 28min ETA • Large Order
MED RISK

Active Intervention — Order #4821

STEP 1 — PACKAGING UPGRADE
Use double-insulated bags for this 4.2km delivery. Temperature loss probability is 73% with standard packaging at this distance.
STEP 2 — ITEM VERIFICATION
Double-check all 3 pizza boxes are correctly sealed. Missing item risk elevated due to multi-order peak volume at this hour.
STEP 3 — DISPATCH TIMING
Delay dispatch by 4 minutes to sync with incoming driver. Current driver is 6 minutes from collection point.
STEP 4 — CUSTOMER COMMUNICATION
Send proactive ETA update. Manage expectations before any complaint trigger point is reached.

Temperature Protection

AI-triggered thermal packaging recommendations based on item type, distance, and real-time weather at dispatch.

Missing Item Prevention

Automated item verification checklists triggered for every high-risk order before sealing and handover to driver.

Packaging Intelligence

Matches container type to dish profile — liquid items, fragile foods, and multi-bag orders handled precisely.

Dispatch Optimization

Synchronizes dispatch timing with driver availability and live traffic to minimize in-transit time and risk.

How the Memory Engine Works

Intervention Recorded

Restaurants & Takeaways

🧠 Outcome Learning Memory — Stored Intelligence Patterns
Every successful intervention is encoded as a reusable pattern to prevent future failures
Live OLM
🌧️ Rain + Sushi + Distance >5km = High Temp Risk
99.1% acc.
Pattern learnt from 34 incidents: 5.8km sushi delivery in rain consistently results in temperature complaints. Intervention: double insulation + hot pack. Prevents 97% of complaints when applied.
🍛 Curry + Liquid Items → Spill-Proof Packaging Required
97.4% acc.
Learnt from 28 curry/liquid incidents. Raita, dhal, and curry sauce require sealed containers. Standard bag results in 64% spill probability over 2km+ routes. Switching to sealed packaging eliminates 97% of spill claims.
⏰ Friday 6-7PM Surge → Pre-Stage Thermal Bags +30 min
94.8% acc.
Volume spikes 42% every Friday 6-8PM. Without pre-staging bags, packing time increases by 3-4 mins per order, creating a cascade of cold food complaints. Pre-staging 30 mins before peak prevents 89% of temperature failures.
👤 High-Refund Customer History → Enhanced Verification
91.2% acc.
Customers with 3+ previous refund claims on any platform have 78% higher complaint probability regardless of actual service quality. Dual-verification and photographic evidence capture reduces dispute losses by 84%.
🍕 Complex Multi-Item Order + Peak Hour = Missing Item Risk
96.3% acc.
Orders with 6+ items placed during kitchen surge periods show 71% increased missing-item probability. Structured packing checklist with verbal confirmation reduces errors to near-zero regardless of order complexity.
